Theme matrix

Several schemes without breaking the brand.

Each scheme keeps the Skye spine: void background, luminous type, glass panels, crown/aura energy, and strong icon frames. Click Preview to apply the scheme across this page.

Sovereign Aurora

Primary Skye command look: void, electric blue, crown gold, cyan aura.

Royal Violet

Luxury founder-grade purple with gold crown pressure and blue-white rim light.

Solar Crown

Gold-first executive signal for premium decks, price cards, and authority surfaces.

Citadel Emerald

Security, infrastructure, vault, compliance, database, and trust lanes.

Blood Moon

High-pressure launch, warning, urgency, command escalation, and cinematic promo surfaces.

Arctic Neon

Clean high-definition AI, docs, office, product tutorial, and developer-room surfaces.

Ghost Steel

Professional neutral steel for legal, docs, enterprise proof, and conservative client pages.

Obsidian Dragon

Streetwear, music, arcade, launch trailers, and more aggressive Skye spectacle.

Image treatment

Every image gets the same discipline.

Use framed images for photography and floating/no-crop frames for logos, icons, transparent renders, UI screenshots, and product mockups. The kit includes themed PNG and SVG variants for the whole icon set.

Component sauce

Paste the look into anything.

These are standalone blocks. Each carries its own scoped CSS. The full component file is included in themes/snippets/SKYE_VISUAL_STANDARD_COMPONENTS_ALL_IN_ONE.html.

Theme orb card

<div class="skye-demo-card" data-skye-theme="sovereign-aurora">
  <style>.skye-demo-card{--void:#04050b;--void-2:#080b18;--ink:#f7fbff;--muted:#a8b6ce;--skye-primary:#20b7ff;--skye-accent:#f7c95b;--skye-aura:#42fff1;max-width:420px;color:var(--ink);font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;border-radius:28px;padding:24px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 0,color-mix(in srgb,var(--skye-primary) 28%,transparent),transparent 36%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.08),rgba(255,255,255,.035)),linear-gradient(135deg,var(--void),var(--void-2));border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--skye-primary) 30%,transparent);box-shadow:0 26px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.38),0 0 70px color-mix(in srgb,var(--skye-primary) 28%,transparent);overflow:hidden;position:relative}.skye-demo-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(115deg,rgba(255,255,255,.08),transparent 35%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--skye-accent) 18%,transparent));pointer-events:none}.skye-demo-card>*{position:relative}.skye-demo-orb{width:86px;height:86px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 38% 28%,#fff,var(--skye-accent) 24%,var(--skye-primary) 56%,var(--void) 100%);box-shadow:0 0 38px color-mix(in srgb,var(--skye-primary) 46%,transparent),0 0 30px color-mix(in srgb,var(--skye-accent) 30%,transparent);margin-bottom:18px}.skye-demo-card small{letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--skye-primary);font-weight:900}.skye-demo-card h3{font-size:1.7rem;line-height:1;margin:10px 0}.skye-demo-card p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.55;margin:0}.skye-demo-card button{margin-top:18px;border:0;border-radius:999px;min-height:42px;padding:0 16px;color:#02040a;font-weight:900;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--skye-accent),var(--skye-primary),var(--skye-aura))}</style>
  <div class="skye-demo-orb"></div><small>Theme locked</small><h3>Command Surface</h3><p>Copy-paste card with the Skye glow, crown accent, dark void, and high-contrast command tone.</p><button>Launch</button>
</div>

Image standard frame

<figure class="skye-image-standard">
  <style>.skye-image-standard{--void:#04050b;--void-2:#080b18;--skye-primary:#20b7ff;--skye-accent:#f7c95b;--skye-aura:#42fff1;width:min(520px,100%);aspect-ratio:16/10;margin:0;border-radius:32px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;background:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 0,color-mix(in srgb,var(--skye-primary) 28%,transparent),transparent 40%),linear-gradient(135deg,var(--void),var(--void-2));border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--skye-primary) 30%,transparent);box-shadow:0 28px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.42),0 0 74px color-mix(in srgb,var(--skye-primary) 26%,transparent)}.skye-image-standard img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;filter:saturate(1.18) contrast(1.14) brightness(1.03)}.skye-image-standard:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(255,255,255,.20),transparent 33%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--skye-primary) 18%,transparent) 64%,transparent);mix-blend-mode:screen;z-index:2}.skye-image-standard:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.045) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.045) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:36px 36px;mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,black,transparent 70%);z-index:3}.skye-image-standard figcaption{position:absolute;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:4;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:18px;background:rgba(2,4,12,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);padding:12px 14px;color:#f7fbff;font:800 .78rem/1.2 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}</style>

Implementation

Drop in three lines.

For the site, load the theme CSS and engine after the existing stylesheet. Then set the theme on the root element or let the floating theme dock handle it.

<link rel="stylesheet" href="/assets/site.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/assets/themes/skye-visual-themes.css">
<script defer src="/assets/themes/skye-theme-engine.js"></script>
<html data-skye-theme="sovereign-aurora">
